exercise.name: Trap Bar Shrug
library_steps: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it like a deadlift.
With arms straight, lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
exercise.one_line_summary: Standing inside a trap bar, arms straight at the sides on the neutral handles; the shoulders lift ~5 cm toward the ears. Upper trapezius does the work.

setup.target: Hexagonal bar around the lifter, handles at the sides, palms facing in.
setup.why: Library step 1; SWIN: the lifter stands inside the hexagonal bar.

movement.measure: lift of the shoulder joint, cm

muscles.emg: Main working muscle of the standard shrug, reported as % MVIC (PIZ, LEE16).
muscles.surface: Top of the shoulders and the back of the neck.

muscles.emg: Grip holds the bar; library secondary.
muscles.role: Helps bend the elbow, most with the palm turned down.
muscles.surface: Thumb side of the upper forearm.

mistakes.why_it_matters: Adds no work for the trapezius.

sources.citation: Swinton PA, Stewart A, Agouris I, Keogh JW, Lloyd R. 2011. A biomechanical analysis of straight and hexagonal barbell deadlifts using submaximal loads. J Strength Cond Res.
sources.what_it_gave: The hexagonal (trap) bar lets the lifter stand inside its frame; heavier loads than a straight bar (265 vs 245 kg 1RM).

sources.citation: Pizzari T, Wickham J, Balster S, Ganderton C, Watson L. 2014. Modifying a shrug exercise can facilitate the upward rotator muscles of the scapula. Clin Biomech.
sources.what_it_gave: Standard shrug (arms by the sides) vs upward-rotation shrug: upper trapezius is the main working muscle of the shrug; EMG as % MVIC for upper, middle and lower trapezius and serratus anterior.

sources.citation: Lee JH, Cynn HS, Choi WJ, Jeong HJ, Yoon TL. 2016. Various shrug exercises can change scapular kinematics and scapular rotator muscle activities in subjects with scapular downward rotation syndrome. Hum Mov Sci.
sources.what_it_gave: Three shrug styles: upper trapezius and levator scapulae lift the shoulder blade; the shrug style changes their ratio.

sources.citation: Ourieff J, Scheckel B, Agarwal A. 2023. Anatomy, Back, Trapezius. StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf).
sources.what_it_gave: Upper trapezius fibres elevate and upwardly rotate the shoulder blade; a superficial muscle from the skull to the lower thoracic spine.
